<h1>brochure</h1>

[Natively multipage `{shiny}` apps.]{.gv-pkg-tagline}

The goal of `{brochure}` is to provide a mechanism for creating natively multi-page `{shiny}`applications, i.e that can serve content on multiple endpoints.
